the headquarters’ knowledge of subsidiary network contexts in the MNC is a key factor for the subsidiary’s competence development.
the MNC headquarters’ knowledge of subsidiary networks is a critical resource for competence development.
The MNC is not a single unit, but is made up of a number of subsidiaries, which are embedded in a number of industrial clusters.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how headquarters’ knowledge of subsidiary network contexts in the MNC influences the development of competence in the MNC.
the question of how headquarters’ knowledge of subsidiary network contexts affects the development of the multinational corporation.
the question of what the headquarters of a multinational corporation can do to support competence development in the subsidiaries.

the subsidiary network context is important in the development of competence in the MNC.

the MNC’s competence development is not driven by organizational arrangements, but by the interaction of the operating units with the industrial clusters in which they are located.
the MNC is a network of knowledge and competence, and the network of knowledge and competencies is created by the interaction of subsidiaries with local actors in their local environments.
the MNCs’ headquarters’ knowledge of the local industrial cluster is important to the subsidiary’s ability to create and develop new knowledge.
